title: 9.6.0 | PTB Patch Notes
body: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/f9dd95c11ecd47893bdb61b5abbbc3459aae49b2.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]Important[/b][/h2][list][*][p]As a result of engine updates, the download file size for this update will be larger than normal.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Features[/b][/h2][h3][b]Diminishing Returns Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]While in a Trial, repeated positive or negative gameplay modifiers and status effects are now affected by diminishing returns.[/p][/*][*][p]Identical modifiers granted by Powers, Items, Perks and Offerings will now be reduced progressively as they become stacked.[/p][list][*][p]Modifiers granted from Killer Power and Survivor Item add-ons are [b]excluded [/b]from diminishing returns.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The gameplay modifier with the highest absolute value is always applied, while lesser ones are progressively lowered to a percentage of their original value[/p][list][*][p]The game prioritizes the highest values, reducing the impact of lesser ones.[/p][list][*][p]1st value (highest) - 100% of modifier[/p][/*][*][p]2nd value - 50% of modifier[/p][/*][*][p]3rd value - 25% of modifier[/p][/*][*][p]4th value - 12.5% of modifier[/p][/*][*][p]5th value and up - 5% of modifier[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Dev note: After 10 years of Dead by Daylight, the ability of Killers and Survivors to stack modifiers indefinitely has enabled ever-accelerating and more intense gameplay. With this update, we aim to normalize how modifiers from different sources interact against each other in order to better preserve the integrity of game. All major gameplay modifiers and status effects for both roles are included in this update.[/i][/p][p][i]Additionally, this change will help us as developers create new interesting Powers, Items and Perks with our roster of existing game modifiers, with far less risk of creating unintended game-breaking scenarios.[/i][/p][p][i]We will be closely monitoring this change during the PTB and look forward to the feedback![/i][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Progress Bar Update[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The progress bar for interactions has a new animation to reinforce the speed differences[/p][/*][*][p]The color has been updated so it represents the speed of the interaction, becoming yellow if faster than normal, and red if slower than normal[/p][list][*][p]Previously, the color was dependent on the individual contributor. Ie. a player could see the bar as red even when going faster[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Visible Team Perks[/b][/h3][list][*][p]The Match Details have been updated to show the loadout of players of a same team[/p][list][*][p]Perks[/p][/*][*][p]Items and addons[/p][/*][*][p]Offerings[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Elements can be hovered to display their descriptions[/p][/*][*][p]The loadout of the opposite team is not displayed until the match is over, following the final Score screen behavior.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Spectator mode[/b][/h3][list][*][p]While in Spectator mode, most elements in the HUD can be hovered to display their description[/p][list][*][p]Perks[/p][/*][*][p]Items[/p][/*][*][p]Add ons[/p][/*][*][p]Goals[/p][/*][*][p]Status Effects[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Auras Customization[/b][/h3][list][*][p]New aura types are available for color customization[/p][list][*][p]Highlighted elements (e.g. as The Xenomorph, looking at specific Control Stations)[/p][/*][*][p]Surfaced elements (e.g. Generators shown by [i]Deja Vu[/i], or because of [i]Eruption[/i])[/p][/*][*][p]Marked elements (e.g. as The Xenomorph, marking a Control Station)[/p][/*][*][p]Killer objects (e.g. The Hag's traps, The Singularity's Biopods)[/p][/*][*][p]Breakable walls.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Content[/b][/h2][h3][b]Killer Updates[/b][/h3][p][b]The Blight[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased The Blight's default movement speed to [b]4.4 m/s[/b] [i](was 4.6 m/s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Breaking a Downed Pallet now reduces Rush tokens down to 2 below maximum, and resets current Rush token recharge to 0%.[/p][list][*][p]Includes basic-break and special-break Killer actions.[/p][/*][*][p]Power description updated to reflect change.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]The Doctor[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased delay of Shock Therapy attack to [b]0.75 seconds [/b][i](was 0.8 seconds)[/i][b].[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Cannibal[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased maximum Chainsaw Sweep speed to [b]5.45 m/s[/b] [i](was 5.35 m/s)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Ghost Face[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased the cooldown of Night Shroud to [b]15 seconds[/b] [i](was 17 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Demogorgon[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased Shred's movement speed to [b]19 m/s[/b] [i](was 18.4 m/s)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased Shred's turn rate to [b]55 degrees [/b]per second [i](was 27.5 degrees per second)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased duration of Undetectable after traversing the Upside Down to [b]12 seconds[/b] [i](was 5 seconds)[/i]. [/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Dredge[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased movement speed while charging Reign of Darkness to[b] 4 m/s [/b][i](was 3.8m/s)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Mastermind[/b][/p][list][*][p]Decreased recovery time of Virulent Bound to [b]2.7 seconds[/b] [i](was 3 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased charge time per token to [b]5 seconds[/b] [i](was 5.5 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Increased duration of the Chain Bound window to [b]2.5 seconds[/b] [i](was 2 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]The Skull Merchant[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added support to when embedded in Survivors to [b]8 seconds [/b][i](was 10 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased battery consumption per Camera in use to [b]6%[/b] [i](was 7%)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Decreased battery consumption upon Survivor teleport to [b]12%[/b] [i](was 15%)[/i].[/p][/*][*][p]Key binding for Grab Axe button updated to use Power input [i](was Attack input)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/be7b6a58c3f298fad4b50a72f8af2358d2d6431a.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]Killer Add-on Updates[/b][/h3][p][b]The Nurse's add-ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Heavy Panting (Rare)[/p][list][*][p]Extends the duration of a lunge after more than one blink by [b]10%[/b] [i](was 30%)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]The Ghost Face's add-ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Walleye's Matchbook (Common)[/p][list][*][p]Decreases Night Shroud recovery time by[b] 2 seconds[/b] [i](was 3 seconds)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]The Mastermind's add-ons[/b][/p][list][*][p]Loose Crank (Uncommon)[/p][list][*][p]Increases movement speed between the first and second Virulent Bounds by [b]15%[/b] [i](was 8%)[/i].[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Egg (Gold) (Rare)[/p][list][*][p]Increases retrieve an axe embedded in the environment by [b]10%[/b] (was 20%).[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Access Panel (Very Rare)[/p][list][*][p]While aiming the Fire Axe, reveals survivors within [b]6 meters[/b] Perk Updates[/b][/h3][p][b]Fast Track[/b][/p][list][*][p]Whenever another Survivor is hooked, you earn 1/2/3 Token(s), up to 9/9/9.[/p][/*][*][p]While repairing, whenever you hit a great basic Skill Check, spend all Tokens. For each Token spent, the Generator gains [b]1/1/1%[/b] permanent progress. [i](was 2%)[/i][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/11814497/3fba5ae864552d07cb8aeee138bf21a278496594.png"][/img][/p][h2][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h2][p][b]Audio[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where missing voice lines for 9 Survivors and 2 Killers in the lobbies and in-trials.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where missing voice line and placeholder subtitle can be seen when entering an offline lobby with The Dark Lord.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where Dungeons & Dragons - 4 Survivors have the wrong music for the D&D cosmetics[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bot Improvements[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed
